title: Communications — Audio Integrating — Interphone Amplifier and Rack Replacement
abstract: Replacement of the discontinued analogue interphone amplifier and its rack by a supported unit with identical interfaces, keeping the existing handsets and the existing wiring in place.

sections.planning_reason: The supplier of the amplifier hybrid audio stage gave notice that the part could no longer be sourced and that repair capability would end in 2021, leaving a population of four hundred and ten units with no support route for at least fifteen more years of service. Shop investigation of no-fault-found removals also found the input stage drifting with temperature, which crews experience as a hum under the speech on long sectors and which no bench test in the manual detects.
sections.description: The amplifier is replaced by a unit with a digital input stage and analogue outputs, mounted in the existing position on a new rack that carries the same four attachment points. The antenna installations are retained. The protective sleeve at the rack feedthrough is renewed because the harness is disturbed, and both connector shells are cleaned and re-pinned where the contact retention is below limits.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on ground power and make sure that the passenger address system is not in use. Do AMM-S-23-50-11-000-035-A to remove the amplifier from the forward equipment area. Remove the rack and clean the mounting face. Install the rack KE27719-48 with the countersunk washers AES832388-10 at the four attachment points. Renew the protective sleeve LN112642-3C at the feedthrough. Install the replacement amplifier and connect both shells. Do AMM-S-23-50-11-400-035-A to install and secure the unit. Do a call test from every cabin station to the flight deck and back, and a sidetone check at each handset. CAUTION: DO NOT MIX AMPLIFIERS OF THE TWO STANDARDS IN ONE AIRCRAFT. THE SIDETONE LEVELS ARE NOT THE SAME. Record the embodiment and return the removed unit.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft from MSN S00097 to MSN S01317 that still carry the original analogue amplifier. Aircraft from MSN S01466 onward are post-modification from build. Aircraft between those two points may or may not be affected and the aircraft record must be checked before the kit is ordered.
sections.material_note: Kit K2350-1012-01 contains the amplifier, the rack, the washer set and the protective sleeve. Lead time is sixteen weeks and the amplifier is the long-lead item. The removed unit is returned to Aeralis and the operator receives credit against the replacement price.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience. Operators are advised to embody before the supplier repair capability ends.
